zh: 在环上访问所有目标，最终走过的部分是一段连续的弧，而没有走的部分恰好落在相邻两个目标之间的空隙里。
没走的那段空隙越长越好，所以应该跳过最大的相邻间隔（包括从最后一个目标绕回第一个目标的那段）。答案=环长−最大间隔。
排序并去重；间隔初值为a[0]+total−a[末尾]（绕回的那段），再与每对相邻目标的差取最大值；输出total减去最大间隔。只有一个目标时答案为0。
en: To visit every target on the ring, the part you walk is one contiguous arc, and the part you skip lies inside a gap between two neighboring targets.
The longer the skipped gap the better, so skip the largest gap between neighboring targets (including the one that wraps from the last target back to the first). Answer = ring length − largest gap.

Sort and deduplicate; start the gap at a[0]+total−a[last] (the wrap-around part), then take the maximum with the difference of each pair of neighboring targets; output total minus the largest gap. With a single target the answer is 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort and deduplicate the points to visit, find the largest gap along the ring between adjacent points, and the answer is the ring length minus that largest gap.

## Proof of correctness

After removing the largest gap, the remaining arc is connected and contains every target, so walking along it once is enough. If a shortest walk covers the whole ring, it takes at least the ring length; otherwise the edges it passes form one arc containing every target, and the part it does not walk cannot span a target, so its length is at most the largest gap. Hence this construction is the shortest.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
